key_path: Register as a seller at seller.flipkart.com (phone OTP, email, GSTIN/PAN, bank account, address verification).
Seller Dashboard -> Manage Profile -> Developer Access -> create Self Access Application (client_id/secret).
client_credentials grant at api.flipkart.net -> access token (~60-day expiry) -> call Seller API v3.
Third-party developers instead: register on Partner Dashboard as 'API Partner' -> Flipkart verifies within ~72h -> create Third Party application -> authorization_code flow with each seller.

agent_native_auth.sandboxes: a sandbox environment is referenced in docs for partners; not self-serve

mcp.directories: Not in Claude directory (404). Only community/3rd-party MCPs (ron2111/flipkart-seller-mcp, Bright Data scraping MCP).
agentic_commerce_protocols: Google UCP early adopter: Gemini/AI Mode 'Buy' button pilot in India from Oct 2026 (hands off to Flipkart checkout) - reported
AI storefronts on ChatGPT/Perplexity/Gemini reported in progress (Apr 2026)

docs_for_agents.openapi: Swagger-style API reference for Seller API v3

score_justification: A self-access client_credentials path exists, but only after Indian seller KYC; no MCP, no llms.txt, and consumer agentic commerce limited to a Google-run pilot.
best_practice: Self-access app with client_credentials for a seller's own account avoids redirect-based OAuth.
biggest_gap: No agent surface (MCP/llms.txt) and seller/partner KYC before any credential.
